Initial release of Flashcard Forge — generate Anki-ready flashcards from any text.

- Converts study material (text, PDFs, notes) into spaced-repetition flashcards.
- Supports Q&A and cloze-deletion modes with regex and sentence analysis.
- Exports Anki-importable CSV (Basic and Cloze types) and JSON.
- Deduplicates cards and ranks by information density.
- Includes robust extraction patterns and customizable output options.
